_readme: The portrait factory's men (docs/briefs/portrait-factory.md; tools/characters/portrait.py). Each: `pictures`, a folder of four plain pictures (front, left, right, back: hatless, flat light, grey ground); `style`, what he should look like in the end, and `style_views` (front, three_quarter, side) where there are more (for the sheet, tools/characters/portrait_sheet.py); optional `macro` (MakeHuman macro targets for his build; else the factory's lean hard man's) and `outfit` (clothes.py's garments and colours). Output: assets/people/<id>_portrait.glb and its textures. `style_hair`: his style portraits' hair, where it differs from his plain pictures' (tools/characters/portrait_style.py paints it so). `hair_fill`: "grey" (default) or "dark", how tools/characters/rodin_portrait.py picks his hair's colour for under the game's hat. `fidelity` (docs/briefs/character-style-fidelity.md; each optional, off when absent): `shape_fit` (his mesh warped to where all his style portraits put his face's landmarks, tools/characters/style_shape.py; "broad": one smooth correction of the whole face, true: a nudge per landmark, which can leave lumps), `patches` "anatomy" with `patch_m` and `patch_compact` (patches grown along his paint's edges, not cubes), `keep_features` (his eyes painted whole from the front portrait, not de-lit, and his face never taken for the portrait's backdrop), `unsquare` (the median that takes the portraits' own squares out, px), `moustache_m` and `brows_m` (metres they stand off his face).

bold_cowboy.style_hair: grey, thick and wavy, to his collar, as in his style portraits
bold_cowboy.what: a weathered frontier man of about forty, bare-headed, thick dark wavy hair to his collar, mutton-chop sideburns, a thick drooping moustache, a brown wool coat over a vest, a white shirt and a black tie

older_heavyset_cowboy.what: a heavy-set frontier man in his late fifties, bare-headed, thick grey hair swept back to his collar, a big grey walrus moustache, heavy jowls and a broad face, a brown wool coat over a vest, a white shirt and a dark tie

young_lean_cowboy.what: a lean young frontier man of about twenty-two, bare-headed, tousled brown hair, clean-shaven with light stubble, a narrow face, a brown coat over a shirt with a red bandana at his neck

bold_cowboy_styled_30.note: The bold cowboy from his plain views repainted in the style (portrait_style.py, LoRA 0.3)

bold_cowboy_styled_60.note: The bold cowboy from his plain views repainted in the style (portrait_style.py, LoRA 0.6)

bold_cowboy_smooth.style_hair: grey, thick and wavy, to his collar, as in his style portraits
bold_cowboy_smooth.note: The bold cowboy with no squares on his face or hair (the smooth-faced test, docs/briefs/portrait-factory.md route 4).

bold_cowboy_painterly.what: a weathered frontier man of about forty, bare-headed, thick dark wavy hair to his collar, mutton-chop sideburns, a thick drooping moustache, a brown wool coat over a vest, a white shirt and a black tie
bold_cowboy_painterly._note: The bold cowboy in Sean's second style (2026-10-15: painterly, fine mosaic, bare-headed; his five paintings, the three-quarter mirrored to face the picture's left), on the bold cowboy's own Rodin bust (`shape`).

bold_cowboy_painterly_lit.what: a weathered frontier man of about forty, bare-headed, thick dark wavy hair to his collar, mutton-chop sideburns, a thick drooping moustache, a brown wool coat over a vest, a white shirt and a black tie
bold_cowboy_painterly_lit._note: As bold_cowboy_painterly with the paintings' own light kept (delight 0.15), to be drawn self-lit. painted_look: the art session's v5 (docs/screenshots/painted_light/README.md), his head in painted mode in the game.

bold_cowboy_body.what: a weathered frontier man of about forty, solid build, standing in an A-pose, bare-chested and barefoot in plain old cream cotton boxer shorts, thick dark wavy hair to his collar, mutton-chop sideburns, a thick drooping moustache
bold_cowboy_body._note: The average base body (docs/briefs/layered-people.md, option 2): Rodin builds him whole from these four pictures (no --bust), his head comes off at the neck ring. Dressed paintings for his clothes: docs/concept/style/portrait-painterly-full-*.

bold_cowboy_dressed.what: a weathered frontier man of about forty standing in an A-pose, bare-headed, a long brown wool coat to his knees, open at the front, a dark brown waistcoat, a white shirt with a high collar, a black tie, a leather belt, dark wool trousers, worn brown leather boots
bold_cowboy_dressed._note: The base body dressed (docs/briefs/layered-people.md): Rodin builds him whole from Sean's four dressed pictures; his clothes are what stands off the bare body (bold_cowboy_body), cut into coat, trousers and boots.

bold_cowboy_vest_dressed.what: a weathered frontier man of about forty standing in an A-pose, bare-headed, no coat, a dark brown waistcoat buttoned, a white shirt with a high collar and buttoned cuffs, a black tie, dark wool trousers tucked into worn brown leather boots with buckled straps
bold_cowboy_vest_dressed._note: The base body dressed without his coat (roadmap 1.3): Rodin builds him whole from Sean's four pictures; his vest, shirt and tie are what stands off the bare body, cut as their own layers under the coat.

bold_cowboy_whole_a._note: Try A for the whole man (tools/characters/head_neck.py, 2026-10-19): the Oct 14 game head with his portrait's chin and jaw, a neck lofted under it, painted smooth from his five portraits (no squares, de-lit, his skin muted).

bold_cowboy_whole_b._note: Try B for the whole man (tools/characters/head_neck.py twin, 2026-10-19): Rodin run 89's own head and neck, set so its eyes are the anatomy's, painted smooth from his five portraits like try A.

bold_cowboy_whole_a2._note: Try A with the Oct 14 face paint (Sean, 2026-10-20; head_neck.py oct14): try A's shape, his head's texels the approved Oct 14 paint as it is (squares and all), its under-brim fills and stray hair fixed; his new neck projected from the portraits with the Oct 14 settings (fidelity, as bold_cowboy's) and cut into the same patches.
